title: l9.release/v1 — repository release declaration
description: Read by `make release` (ops/scripts/l9_release.py) from <repo>/.l9/release.json. Declares what one L9 repository releases and how; it grants no publication authority.

repository.description: owner/name on GitHub. Must equal the workspace's origin.

default_branch.description: Branch a release is cut from. Defaults to main.

ecosystems.description: Build adapters, run in order. Every declared version authority must carry the same version.

version_authority.description: Repository-relative file holding the version: pyproject.toml [project].version for python-uv, package.json .version for node-npm.

artifacts.description: Exact asset file names the build must produce, `{version}` substituted. The build must produce exactly this set; each is uploaded to the Release.

major_tag.description: none: never touch a vN tag. advance: create vN when absent; when present and behind, hand the operator the lease command (make release never force-pushes).

changelog.description: Repository-relative changelog with a dated `## X.Y.Z - YYYY-MM-DD` section for the release.

pre_release.description: Optional repository-specific gate run in the clean gate checkout after `make setup validate check test`. argv, never a shell string.
